data.title: Top 3 Price Prediction: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple – BTC, ETH and XRP retreat as Fed rate decision looms | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH) and Ripple (XRP) remain under pressure and consolidate at the time of writing on Wednesday after falling more than 3%, 4% and 9%, respectively, as the Clarity Act failed to advance in the Senate on Tuesday.
